concerns.text: FR-001 requires the system to download **≥ 50** CIF files. Task T009 only specifies downloading CIFs for materials with a thermal‑conductivity tensor but does not assert or test that at least 50 files are obtained, weakening the functional requirement.
SC-003 mandates verification that the final dataset contains **≥ 50** materials. No task explicitly checks or asserts this count after filtering, leaving the success criterion untested.

FR-010 requires documentation of sample‑size and power considerations. T017 only logs a warning when n < 50; the required documentation is never embedded in the final report (see T022), so the functional requirement is effectively weakened.

SC-005 specifies that the full analysis must complete within **6 hours** on the prescribed hardware. T024 verifies artifact existence and schema compliance but does not measure or enforce the runtime limit, making the success criterion untestable.

FR-010 also expects the final report to contain sample‑size/power information. T022 generates the report with the mandatory “Limitations” paragraph but does not include any sample‑size or power‑analysis summary, thus not satisfying the requirement.
